'''Hitomi Nabatame''' (Japanese: '''生天目仁美''' ''Nabatame Hitomi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Nabatame was born on August 4, 1976, in {{wp|Sado, Niigata|Sado}}, {{wp|Niigata Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She began her work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|DP}}, but her two major roles were {{kal|Grace}} and [[Clemont's Chespin]] in {{aniseries|XY}}. Nabatame is currently affiliated with Ken Production.
